## Define the ICR gene set, grouped by functional category

```{python}
icr_genes = {
  "th1_signaling":["IFNG", "TBX21", "IL12B", "STAT1", "IRF1"],
  "t_cell_markers": ["CD8A", "CD8B"],
  "chemoattraction": ["CXCL9", "CXCL10", "CCL5"],
  "cytotoxic_effectors": ["GNLY", "PRF1", "GZMA", "GZMB", "GZMH"],
  "immune_checkpoint": ["CD274", "PDCD1", "CTLA4", "IDO1", "FOXP3"],
}

all_icr_genes = [g for group in icr_genes.values() for g in group]
```

## check if ICR genes in counts genes

```{python}
def check_gene_coverage(counts: pd.DataFrame) -> list:
    """Confirm all 20 ICR genes are present before scoring; report any missing."""
    missing = [g for g in all_icr_genes if g not in counts.index]
    if missing:
        print(f"WARNING: {len(missing)} ICR genes not found in expression matrix: {missing}")
        print("Check gene symbol version (e.g. FOXP3 vs old aliases) or Ensembl ID mapping.")
    else:
        print("All 20 ICR genes present.")
    return missing

missing_genes = check_gene_coverage(counts)
```

## Compute the composite ICR score per sample

```{python}
def compute_icr_score(counts: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    
    # Keep only ICR genes present in your data
    present_genes = [g for g in all_icr_genes if g in counts.index]
    icr_expr = counts.loc[present_genes]

    # Z-score normalization per gene
    #z = (expression − gene_mean_across_samples) / gene_std
    z = icr_expr.sub(icr_expr.mean(axis=1), axis=0).div(icr_expr.std(axis=1), axis=0)

    #group score = mean(z-scores of its genes)
    group_scores = {}
    for group_name, genes in icr_genes.items():
        genes_present = [g for g in genes if g in z.index]
        if genes_present:
            group_scores[group_name] = z.loc[genes_present].mean(axis=0)

    score_df = pd.DataFrame(group_scores)

    # Final ICR score
    #icr_score = mean(all group scores)
    score_df["icr_score"] = score_df.mean(axis=1)

    return score_df
```

```{python}
score_df = compute_icr_score(counts)
score_df.head()
```

```{python}
def correlate_scores(
    icr_df: pd.DataFrame,
    mito_score: pd.Series,
    faoscore: pd.Series,
    subtype: pd.Series = None,
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """
    icr_df: output of compute_icr_score() — must include 'icr_score'
    mito_score, faoscore: existing per-sample scores, indexed by sample ID
    subtype: optional PAM50 subtype per sample, for stratified correlation
 
    Returns a tidy table of Spearman rho / p-value, overall and per subtype.
    """
    combined = icr_df[["icr_score"]].join(
        pd.DataFrame({"mito_score": mito_score, "fao_score": faoscore})
    ).dropna()
 
    results = []
 
    def _corr_block(df, label):
        for target_col in ["mito_score", "fao_score"]:
            rho, p = stats.spearmanr(df["icr_score"], df[target_col])
            results.append(
                {"group": label, "vs": target_col, "n": len(df), "rho": rho, "p": p}
            )
 
    _corr_block(combined, "overall")
 
    if subtype is not None:
        combined = combined.join(subtype.rename("subtype"))
        for subtype_name, sub_df in combined.groupby("subtype"):
            _corr_block(sub_df, subtype_name)
 
    return pd.DataFrame(results)
```

```{python}
icr_df = score_df[["icr_score"]]
mito_score = mito_score.squeeze()
corr_results = correlate_scores(icr_df , mito_score, fao_score, subtype)
corr_results
```

Basal-like tumors specifically, higher FAO activity associates with a *more* immune-active (immune-hot) phenotype

```{python}
counts_df = counts.T
dds = DeseqDataSet(
    counts=counts_df,
    metadata=sample_metadata,
    design_factors="condition",
    refit_cooks=True,
)

dds.deseq2()   # fits size factors, dispersions, normalizes — this populates dds.layers["normed_counts"]
```

```{python}
print(counts.columns[:5])
print(sample_metadata.index[:5])
```

```{python}

from scipy.stats import ranksums

normed_counts = pd.DataFrame(
    dds.layers["normed_counts"],
    index=dds.obs_names,      # samples
    columns=dds.var_names,    # genes
)
counts_basal_normed = normed_counts.loc[basal_samples]

expr = counts_basal_normed            
expr_log = np.log2(expr + 1)         
 
#Wilcoxon rank-sum per gene
results = []
for gene in expr.columns:
    high = expr.loc[group == "FAO_high", gene]        
    low  = expr.loc[group == "FAO_low", gene]
 
    high_log = expr_log.loc[group == "FAO_high", gene]  
    low_log  = expr_log.loc[group == "FAO_low", gene]
 
    stat, p = ranksums(high, low)
 
    results.append({
        "gene": gene,
        "stat": stat,
        "p": p,
        "logFC": high_log.mean() - low_log.mean(),      
    })
 
de_results = pd.DataFrame(results).set_index("gene")
```

```{python}
from statsmodels.stats.multitest import multipletests

de_results["padj"] = multipletests(de_results["p"], method="fdr_bh")[1]

de_results = de_results.sort_values("padj")
de_results.head()
```
